post.text:
In our submission opposing South Wairarapa District Council proposed bylaw to restrict access on an unformed legal road at Cape Palliser we said the council’s proposed bylaw is unprecedented. Roads exist to provide public
access, but the bylaw seeks to prohibit public access.

source.agency_name: Herenga ā Nuku Aotearoa (Outdoor Access Commission)
source.notes: Public AT Protocol profile and posts can be captured without live-posting side effects.
